title: Freedom
theme: Pizza Day · freedom from brokey / stacking sats
description: Created while ROBBIE P was working toward the Dread Pirate Robbie album, Freedom took longer to finish. Guitars at FBT Studios in Detroit; final production in El Salvador. Pizza Day series (May 22, 2026). Come-up on thin paper money, stacking sats, HODL through heat, and whether freedom from "brokey" holds — or reads as a mirage.
